title: Alert-List Concordance for Evaluating Imputation Strategies in ICU Sepsis Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.22635v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Preprocessing is an under-measured reliability risk in clinical prediction: a model can keep a similar AUROC and still change who receives an alert. Imputation quality is commonly evaluated using reconstruction error or aggregate discrimination, neither of which directly measures agreement on which patients are flagged. At a matched alert rate, pipelines with similar aggregate performance can produce different patient lists. This question is especially relevant under the frequent, structured missingness of real ICU records. We therefore introduce alert-list concordance, which asks whether two pipelines identify the same high-risk patients, measured by the Jaccard similarity of their top-k% alert sets with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. On PhysioNet/CinC 2019 (40,336 patients, 71.9% missingness), we compare nine imputation strategies and a native-missingness baseline using a fixed XGBoost configuration, fitted and Platt-cal

translated_title: 评估ICU脓毒症预测中插补策略的警报列表一致性方法
translated_abstract: 预处理是临床预测中一种未被充分衡量的可靠性风险：模型可以保持相似的AUROC，却改变了哪些患者会收到警报。插补质量通常通过重建误差或总体判别性能来评估，但这两者都无法直接衡量模型在标记哪些患者方面的一致性。在匹配的警报率下，总体性能相似的流程可能产生不同的患者列表。在真实ICU记录中频繁且呈结构性的数据缺失情况下，这一问题尤为突出。因此，我们提出了“警报列表一致性”（alert-list concordance）这一指标，用于考察两个流程是否识别出相同的高风险患者，通过其前k%警报集合的Jaccard相似度以及患者级别的bootstrap置信区间来衡量。在PhysioNet/CinC 2019数据集（40,336名患者，71.9%缺失率）上，我们使用固定的XGBoost配置，比较了九种插补策略与一个原生缺失基线，模型经过拟合和Platt校准……
tldr: 该研究提出了“警报列表一致性”这一新指标，通过比较前k%警报患者集合的Jaccard相似度来评估不同插补策略在ICU脓毒症预测中是否识别出相同的高风险患者，弥补了传统重建误差和总体判别指标无法衡量患者级别警报一致性的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "alert-list concordance," a novel metric based on the Jaccard similarity of top-k% alert sets, to evaluate whether different imputation strategies in ICU sepsis prediction flag the same high-risk patients, addressing a gap left by reconstruction error and aggregate discrimination metrics.
